thread:
olivia: Hey team — quick heads up on Venatrix7B int4 onboard. Ran our standard summarization suite and saw perplexity jump ~12% and repeating tokens after ~128 tokens. int8 looks fine. Suspect tokenizer -> conversion -> rotary/kvcache mismatch related to soft-hyphen/zwj tokens. Anyone seen this pattern?

sam: Which conversion + quant pipeline did you use?

olivia: model-converter v2.3.2 -> GGUF, then quantlyzer int4. Command I used:
```
model-converter convert --input venatrix7b.ckpt --out venatrix7b.gguf --tokenizer venatrix-tokenizer.json --roptable auto
quantlyzer quant --model venatrix7b.gguf --bits 4 --calib 2048
```
Sample failing prompt: "Summarize: On the regulatory changes..." -> output loops / truncates after 128 tokens.

ravi: Can you dump tokenizer special tokens and a short qkv diff (single layer)?

olivia: quick dump: `python -c "import json; print(json.load(open('venatrix-tokenizer.json'))['special_tokens'][:12])"` shows soft-hyphen(U+00AD) and ZWJ(U+200D) as ids [209,210] in source, but GGUF shows them swapped. Also observed headwise rotary phase mismatch for heads 8-11 in int4 runs.

leah: If special token ids get permuted during convert, kv-cache indexing can be off when streaming -> explains incremental duplication. Does single-shot generation reproduce the bug?

olivia: Single-shot ok. Incremental (streaming) duplicates starting at token 129 every run.

sam: That points to kv-cache / rotary index sync being broken when token ids change. Two quick actions: (1) re-export with preserve-token-ids option, (2) add a regression test comparing incremental vs single-shot on a set of anchors. I'll write the ROUGE/perplexity check.

ravi: I dumped qkv for layer 10 float32 vs int4: saw a one-step shift in key indexing for a subset of heads. Looks like a serialization ordering bug in our converter that only surfaces with quant kernel permutations. I'll try re-export with `--preserve-token-ids` and re-run quant.

deploy-bot: CI note: added conversion-preserve-ids toggle to staging pipeline.

sam: For triage I'll add a quick gate: run 32 anchor prompts, compute ROUGE + perplexity; if int4 divergence >5% vs float32, fail onboarding. Also add kv continuity check (incremental vs single-shot token sequence equality).

olivia: FYI int8 run didn't show duplication at all, so this is int4-specific. Could be inner-kernel reorder exposing the bug.

ravi: Update (30m): re-exported with preserve flag and re-quantized. Incremental vs single-shot now match, ROUGE ~1.1% delta vs float32. Looks fixed. Will open PR with converter patch and reproduction test.

leah: Great. After PR lands: run full summarization + long-chat benchmarks and annotate onboarding doc with the token-id swap finding and the required preserve flag. Mark Venatrix7B int4 onboarding blocked until CI runs pass.

olivia: Thanks all — assigning tasks: sam -> ROUGE gate + CI; ravi -> PR + repro artifacts; olivia -> collate logs and tests into onboarding ticket. ETA EOD today. :thumbsup:
